items.name: Starting
items.looks: Making things, but nothing is out yet, or what's out hasn't been seen. No audience, no sales, no streams.
items.up: Get a first group of people to see the work and react.

items.name: Building
items.looks: A small audience. A few hundred or a few thousand followers. Some streams or sales. Doing everything yourself.
items.constraint: Growth only comes from your own posting, and your time runs out.
items.up: Get seen by people who don't follow you yet.

items.name: Growing
items.looks: A real audience. Consistent sales or streams. Maybe a first hire, a manager or a small team.
items.constraint: You've outgrown what your own page and your own hours can do.
items.up: Get your work in front of many more people than you can reach yourself.

items.name: Established
items.looks: Known in your niche or city. A team. Steady income. Launches that land with your existing audience.
items.constraint: New people don't find you unless you pay, and most of that spend doesn't come back.
items.up: Turn every launch into something far more people see than your own audience.

items.name: Scaling
items.looks: Big audience, real revenue, a team that runs things. Launches, releases or drops on a schedule.
items.constraint: Every launch is a fresh fight for attention. The results change month to month.
items.up: Make reach predictable, so every launch lands at the size you need.

items.name: Leading
items.looks: A household name in your category. Millions of followers, big numbers, a full team.
items.constraint: Staying everywhere, all the time, while the moments and content keep coming.
items.up: Keep the whole machine fed, every week, without it eating the team.

objections.kicker: The questions we get on every call
objections.body: Six of the questions we hear most from brands on the fence. Each one answered straight, in under two minutes.

items.q: Will this reach our actual audience?
Can we push this to after our launch?
How fast can a campaign go live?
What actually happens in a campaign?
a: It's not a promo package. It's a real campaign. On our network.
Expect zero fake views. Meaning, every view is checked.
In week one, we set it up end to end. We pick the content with you, match it to pages in your niche and your countries, and brief our clippers.
Then it goes live, and you watch every post and every view on your own dashboard.

items.q: What do we walk away with?
a: Real views on your own content, and a clear read on what worked.
You spend time with our team. We go through which pages and countries responded, and what that means for your brand.
It's hands-on help specific to your biggest reach problem.

items.q: Is this right for our size or industry?
a: Budget: if your marketing budget is under $10K a month, this is not a fit (yet).
If you're spending $10K to $500K a month on marketing, then we can help. How is it possible to have such a wide range?
Answer: every campaign is built around your budget, your niche and your countries.

items.q: How much does a campaign cost?
a: That gives you access to our network (3,000+ clippers across TikTok, Reels and Shorts), a brief, view checks and payout rules.
If you can't invest that, don't book. If you can, chances are we can help.
